notes:
Account background:
- Customer since 2022 on Hosted API for chat + embeddings (prod). 2025 avg usage ~35M tokens/mo; seasonal peaks up to 70M.
- Current ask: Dedicated upgrade for core chat routing to guarantee p95 <100ms and consistent throughput; Optimize adoption to reduce per-token costs across non-critical paths; EU region residency for EU customers.
Recent timeline & activities:
- 2026-01-12: Initial renewal conversation (Jordan). customer signaled interest in Dedicated reserve for Q3 usage spike.
- 2026-02-03: Security review kickoff (Marina). Provided SOC2 pack + network diagram.
- 2026-02-18: 2-week Dedicated POC started (canary traffic ~10%). Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_7731.
- 2026-03-04: POC review w/ eng + product. p95 reduced from ~220ms (hosted) to ~75ms (Dedicated pool) for standard chat rigs. Fireflies ff_2026-03-04_8892.
- 2026-03-09: Optimize pilot proposal shared (50% traffic, 6 weeks) to evaluate batching and quantization impact on fidelity and cost. Pricing deck link in Drive.
POC notes & technical requirements:
- Workloads: high-concurrency chat (live agents), embeddings for personalization, reranking for search.
- Latency target: p95 <100ms for chat; 99thSLO objective for live-agent handoff. Throughput target: sustained 1200 rps during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: high for embeddings and background rerank; willing to invest in Dedicated for chat if Optimize reduces infra spend by ~20-30%.
- Model preferences: open to Llama2-variants and legal-approved LLMs; want fallback routing to smaller quantized models during overload.
- Networking: require VPC peering, egress controls, and IP allowlist for Dedicated pool.
- Compliance: SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 1 year, EU residency for EU customer data.
Quotes & sentiment:
- Tom Nguyen (Head of Product): "We need predictable sub-100ms p95 for agent routing — spikes break the UX."
- Security lead: "Need confirmation of data residency language in SOW before legal signs."
Open items / blockers:
- Procurement timing: finance working on PO cadence; risk of slipping to Q4 if PO not issued by May.
- Legal: final EU residency clause + DPA redlines outstanding.
- Network: infra team still validating egress policy with customer SREs (security ticket SEC-2211).
Next steps (short):
- AE to send final Dedicated sizing + pricing (Jordan) by 2026-03-15.
- SE (Marina) to run Optimize trial plan kickoff 2026-03-22; measurement plan to include cost delta and quality regression tests.
- CSM (Devon) to prepare onboarding and runbook for Dedicated swap + canary rollback plan upon PO close.
